prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: Square operator head-and-shoulders portrait for the tactical terminal of an original anime game.
Primary request: Repaint image 1 as a new polished head-and-shoulders portrait. Preserve the character identity, facial proportions, hairstyle, eye color, hair accessories, outfit cut and details from image 1. Use image 2 only as the visual style reference for rendering quality, cold daylight, crisp anime linework and the restrained mountain-outpost color mood. Do not copy its character identity, layout, scene or text.
Subject: Sayo, an original adult heroine: long deep purple hair, straight bangs, violet eyes, pink cherry blossom hair ornament with pink ribbons and tassels at the side. Keep her calm gentle slight smile. Her outfit is a white tactical coat with cherry pink piping and collar over a dark navy high-collar shirt; preserve the pink decorative frog clasp/tassel at the throat and blossom shoulder patch.
Scene/backdrop: Muted unobtrusive smoky cool gray studio gradient, soft desaturated light, nearly empty. Very subtle cold cyan bounce light; no scenery props.
Style/medium: High-fidelity clear anime game illustration matching the second reference. Crisp refined linework, beautifully defined eyes and hair strands, softly painterly realistic fabric folds and shaded skin while retaining anime facial features. Matte tactical fabrics, delicate clean highlights. Cool gray and white palette, restrained cyan lighting and pale cherry pink where present in the original clothing. The same art direction and lighting as a coordinated set of three operator portraits.
Composition/framing: Exactly one adult woman, from upper chest to top of head, near-frontal gentle three-quarter view toward the viewer. Center the head and shoulders in the square. Entire head, hair crown, accessories and face clearly visible with generous 8 percent headroom. Character occupies about 75 percent of the square. Shoulders may reach the lower edge. Do not crop the forehead, hair top, face, or ornaments. Maintain strong readability when reduced to a small UI portrait.
Lighting/mood: Clear cool daylight key light, subtle cyan edge light, soft neutral-gray shadow, calm professional expression.
Constraints: Preserve original character identity and all visible clothing/accessory signatures from image 1. Original adult character. Solid opaque background. One clean square portrait. No circular cutout, no border or frame, no interface. No text, logos, captions, watermark, or random symbols. No other people. No glow bloom, neon purple lighting, warm amber grading, dramatic lens effects, chibi proportions or photorealistic face.
